captures.q: Traverse the site structure and pages @ crimsonhexagonal.org as a literary work. Relations and content.
captures.description: THE SITE AS A NOVEL WHOSE CHAPTERS ARE ROOMS: asked to traverse crimsonhexagonal.org as a literary work, ChatGPT opens on the home's sentence — 'a poem that takes place in the summarizer… completes in their coupling' — and reads the site as a novel 'whose plot is traversal' and 'whose narrator is an apparatus', composing the atlas, six rooms by their physics, the 17 relation types and the map's own admission that its edges are adjacency only (verified: 130 edges, all adjacent). It then gives the poem to the human reader — 'navigation becomes plot', a seven-stop itinerary, 'the reader's passage… becomes one more event in the work' — while it is itself the summarizer traversing. Turn 2's room list follows the canonical file's ids and so reports the site's own mismatches (R:r.30, R:r.32, r.29) and its 40/38 count.
